financialRule: Source receipt cash across tax years and unsplit charges is not annual assessment, overdue balance, collection rate or project uplift.
publicPayloadApproval: Required separately from runtime rendering checks; UI hiding cannot secure a shipped static file.
deploymentGate: Root review of final sanitized payload and local QA before any publication.

caregroups.countGrain: distinct stored source keys, not verified people or all current city patients
caregroups.groupDefinitionStatus: awaiting confirmation; printed group3/4 descriptions are identical
caregroups.conditionKeywordMeaning: literal overlapping source terms, not confirmed diagnoses or prevalence

optionalBreakdowns.values: finite number or null; escaped text; exact source units
optionalBreakdowns.aggregation: explicit source grains; no automatic sum across rows or tables

taxForms.reexportRule: PDS7/8 equal across 1,419,353 source cells by value and type; binary hashes differ, no duplicate source-file count
taxForms.crossFormCandidateLink: corroborating keys; ambiguous rows held; not effective assessment or individual tax gap

legacyPayloadCompatibility: The four required views remain valid without optional caregroups; no unknown dataset IDs accepted.

terrainRuntimeOverride.consumerOverride: app.js overrides only the in-memory terrain entry to ready_external_dem when both approved external metadata files load
